description: Construction budget tracking web app. Next.js 15 + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend, Flask + MongoDB backend.

global_layout.structure: Two-panel layout on a light-gray page background (#B8B8B8-ish outer canvas). Left sidebar (fixed width ~184px, white background, rounded corners) + main content panel (white background, rounded corners) filling the rest of the viewport, with an outer gray gutter/margin around both.

sidebar.active_item_style: Light gray rounded-rectangle background behind the active label, darker/bolder text than inactive items
sidebar.footer_position: Bottom of sidebar, separated from nav by empty space (sidebar is tall with lots of whitespace between nav and footer)

header_pattern.description: Every main-content page repeats this header block at the top

elements.style: Small gray text directly under title, e.g. 'Manage and track all construction projects'
Rounded pill input top-center-right area, placeholder 'Search.....', magnifying-glass icon on left inside input
Rounded pill toggle top-right, filled black circle on right side (appears to be a dark/light mode or on/off toggle)

filter_row.description: Row beneath header on list pages

elements.label: All projects
elements.style: Bordered rounded-rectangle button with chevron-down icon

elements.label: All projects
elements.style: Second identical dropdown, appears only on Documents page (project filter distinct from type filter)
Solid green filled rounded button, white text, plus-icon prefix, right-aligned

color_tokens.status_active: green pill badge, dark-green text on light-green background, label 'Active'
color_tokens.status_complete: yellow pill badge, black text, label 'complete' (lowercase, unlike others)
color_tokens.status_onhold: gray pill badge, label 'onhold' (lowercase, no space)
color_tokens.progress_text_color: varies per row — green, orange/yellow, or red text depending on percentage value (not a bar-only indicator; the % text itself is colored)
color_tokens.row_leading_dot: Small colored circle to the left of project/item name on Projects and Equipment tables; color appears to correlate loosely with status but is inconsistently applied in the mock

screens.name: Projects
screens.subtitle: Manage and track all construction projects
screens.row_notes: Each row: colored leading dot + project name (e.g. 'Skyline'), city location (Lagos, Abuja, Ikeja, Enugu, Ibadan, Lokoja, Owerri), 'Manager' placeholder text, status pill, budget value with M suffix (e.g. '17.43M'), start/end dates, progress % in colored text

screens.name: Tasks
screens.subtitle: Track and manage project tasks
screens.layout_type: Kanban board, 4 columns with dark gray header bar spanning all columns

elements: Task title (bold), e.g. 'Executive function', 'Concrete foundation', 'Plumbing rough-in', 'Slab-decking'
Project name subtitle, e.g. 'Skyline apartments', 'Oceanview resort'
Priority/status pill badge: 'high' (red/pink), 'Medium' (peach/orange), or 'Completed' (purple) depending on column
Assignee avatar: solid black circle, bottom-left of card
Either a due date ('Due 23 june') OR a progress bar with % label (e.g. 65%, 40%) depending on column — To do cards show due date, In progress/In review/Completed cards show a progress bar

screens.note: 3 rows of cards visible, each row reusing the same 4 task types across columns (mock data, not meant to be taken literally per-column)

screens.name: Equipment
screens.subtitle: Track and manage project tasks
screens.note: Column headers use inconsistent casing in the mock (lowercase 'equipment', 'type', 'utilisation' vs capitalized 'Location', 'Status') — flag for the agent to normalize to consistent casing in the real build. 'Backhloader' is likely a typo for 'Backhoe loader'.

screens.name: Inventory
screens.subtitle: Track materials and stock levels
screens.layout_note: Reuses the exact same table structure/columns/data as the Equipment page in this mock (equipment/type table rather than a materials/stock table) — treat as a placeholder; real Inventory page should show materials + stock quantities, not equipment utilisation.

screens.name: Reports
screens.subtitle: Track materials and stock levels
screens.layout_note: Also reuses the Equipment/Inventory table verbatim in this mock, with an extra 'All projects' filter dropdown top-right and a duplicated column header row (columns appear twice, once above the search bar and once below) — likely a mock artifact rather than intentional; real Reports page should have distinct report content (charts/summaries), not a repeated equipment table.

screens.name: Documents
screens.subtitle: Track materials and stock levels
screens.note: Sidebar nav highlights 'Inventory' as active even though header title is 'Documents' — likely mock inconsistency; clarify routing with the agent (Documents may be a sub-view or modal under Inventory rather than its own top-level nav item).

screens.name: AI assistant
elements: Empty white main panel (no messages shown)
Bottom-anchored chat input bar: light-gray rounded pill container
Plus icon (attachment) on far left of input
Text input field (empty, no placeholder visible)
Microphone icon button (dark circle) inside input bar
Up-arrow send button (dark, square) at far right of input bar

open_questions_for_agent_prompt: Confirm whether Inventory and Reports should be distinct table schemas from Equipment, since the mocks reuse identical placeholder data across all three.
Confirm correct nav highlighting per route (Documents mock shows Inventory as the active sidebar item).
Confirm intended casing convention for table headers (mixed Title Case and lowercase across screens).
Confirm status taxonomy per entity type: Projects use Active/Delayed/complete/onhold; Equipment uses Active/Inactive/Maintenance — decide whether these are separate enums or a shared one.
